directions.name: Lane Line
directions.summary: Pool-tile aqua with lane-rope navy: athletic without the usual black and red.
directions.curation: Taken from the swimming pool: tiled water and lane markings. A fitness option that departs from dark grounds with red or orange.

reasoning.claim: Lane Navy reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Pool Tile, so numbers and schedules read clearly on the color.
A cool, clean pair suggests training and recovery rather than aggression.

directions.watch_out: Aqua grounds look clinical without photography of people moving.
directions.choose_if: a fitness brand wants clean and athletic rather than the usual black and red
do: Use Pool Tile as the main field.
Set numbers and timetables in Lane Navy.

directions.name: Fetch
directions.summary: Tennis-ball yellow-green with a collar navy: cheerful and practical.
directions.curation: Built from the toy itself: a tennis-ball field with dark navy type, playful without pastel cuteness.

reasoning.claim: Collar Navy reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Tennis Ball, so type sits directly on the color.
A toy color as the ground feels playful and specific to pets without paw-print clichés.

directions.watch_out: The yellow-green field is strong. Keep product photography on white panels.
directions.choose_if: a pet brand wants playful packaging without paw-print clichés
do: Use Tennis Ball for packaging fronts and hero fields.
avoid: Do not add paw prints or bone icons as decoration.

directions.name: Standby
directions.summary: Device black and display white with one tiny indicator green.
directions.curation: Taken from the product: black hardware, a white display and a single status light, so the device stays the hero.

reasoning.claim: Display White reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Device Black, so specs and type are crisp.
Indicator Green holds 2% of the declared area, used only where something is on or available.

directions.watch_out: Black product shots disappear on a black ground. Light products from the side or use white panels.
directions.choose_if: a hardware or device brand should let the product stay the hero
do: Use Indicator Green only for "on", "in stock" or the primary action.

directions.name: Cyanotype
directions.summary: Prussian blue with a cool print white, like a cyanotype.
directions.curation: Taken from the cyanotype, a nineteenth-century photographic and botanical printing process: deep Prussian blue with white where light was blocked.

reasoning.claim: Print White reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Prussian Blue, so diagrams and text read on the field.
The process links science, documentation and image-making, which suits research institutions and archives.

directions.watch_out: A blue field throughout can feel heavy for long papers. Provide a white reading layout.
directions.choose_if: a research, archive or science brand wants a documentary, historical reference
do: Use the blue field for covers, diagrams and section openers.
avoid: Do not add a second hue.

directions.name: Club Cream
directions.summary: A cream ground with club burgundy: established, warm and particular.
directions.curation: The language of old clubs, outfitters and labels: a tinted cream with one deep red, without gold or crests in metallic ink.

reasoning.claim: Club Burgundy reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Club Cream, so labels and text read clearly.
A deep red on cream feels long-established without looking antique.

directions.watch_out: Easy to tip into pastiche. Keep type and layout contemporary.
directions.choose_if: a heritage or specialty brand wants an established feel without antique pastiche
do: Use Club Burgundy for type, labels and the mark.
avoid: Do not add gold or faux-aged textures.

directions.name: Kraft and Black
directions.summary: Brown kraft paper with stamp-black type.
directions.curation: Taken from packaging: kraft paper, rubber stamps and black ink, so the shop and the parcel look the same.

reasoning.claim: Stamp Black reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Kraft, so labels and prices read clearly.
Kraft and black feels direct and hands-on, which suits independent and specialty retail.

directions.watch_out: Kraft grounds read as eco by default. Make sure that matches the product.
directions.choose_if: an independent shop wants the store and the parcel to look the same
do: Use Kraft for packaging and page backgrounds.
avoid: Do not add green leaf icons.

directions.name: Risograph
directions.summary: Fluorescent pink and riso blue, as in a two-color risograph print.
directions.curation: Taken from the risograph: two spot inks that overprint, a staple of independent print and illustration.

reasoning.claim: Riso Blue reaches {ratio:figure/ground} on Fluoro Pink, so it is used for large type and illustration.
Two spot colors give campaigns and illustration a handmade, printed energy.

directions.watch_out: Pink and blue vibrate at small sizes. Keep body text in the derived dark neutral.
directions.choose_if: a campaign, studio or illustration project wants handmade two-ink print energy
do: Use both inks in large shapes and overprints.
avoid: Do not add a third ink.
